metadata.scope: Statewide. Supersedes the 2-mile NCT corridor pull (pull-motorized-mn-corridor.py) and the 5-mile clip idea; the corridor files stay on disk.
metadata.miles_method: Whole features measured in UTM 15N (EPSG:26915); no clipping, so field and drawn miles agree except where the service itself splits a trail.
